table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GroupCode= 
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END,   
	GroupName= 
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date,
	Customer=A.Name,
	CustomerAlias=A.AliasName,
	TotalSaleValue = Round(SUM(S.LooseQty * ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE I.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) ), 2),
	DiscValue= Round(SUM((S.ItemFlatDisc * S.LooseQty) + 
		(S.LooseQty * (S.SalePrice - S.ItemFlatDisc) * S.DiscPerc * 0.01) +
		(S.LooseQty * (S.SalePrice - S.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01) * S.InvDiscPerc * 0.01) + 
		CASE S.TP - S.SalePrice WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (S.TP - S.SalePrice) * S.LooseQty END), 2)

FROM
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	(SELECT 
		S.SaleInvCode,
		S.Date,
		S.CustCode,
		D.ICode,
		D.LooseQty,
		D.BonusQty,
		D.ItemFlatDisc,
		D.DiscPerc,
		D.SalePrice,
		TP = Round(D.PackPrice / CASE D.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.PackUnits END, 2),
		InvDiscPerc=S.DiscPerc
	FROM
		SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D, Item I
	WHERE
		:as_saletype IN (1,2) AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.DATE <= :ad_enddate AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ai_groupcode)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		S.SaleInvCode,
		S.Date,
		S.CustCode,
		D.ICode,
		D.LooseQty,
		D.BonusQty,
		D.ItemFlatDisc,
		D.DiscPerc,
		D.SalePrice,
		TP = Round(D.PackPrice / CASE D.PackUnits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.PackUnits END, 2),
		InvDiscPerc=S.DiscPerc
	FROM
		SaleLedger S, SaleInvDetail D, Item I
	WHERE
		:as_saletype IN (1,3) AND
		S.impactinventory = 'N' AND
		S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		S.Posted = 'Y' AND
		S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.DATE <= :ad_enddate AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ai_groupcode)	) S
WHERE 
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	I.ICode = S.ICode AND
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ai_groupcode)
GROUP BY
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.Packcode
ORDER BY
	GroupName,
	SaleInvCode,
	Date,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName
table.sort: groupname A, saleinvcode A, date A, customer A

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: Round((sum(discvalue for group 1) / if( sum(totalsalevalue for group 1) = 0, 1, sum(totalsalevalue for group 1) )) * 100, 2)
